mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS MoM > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is stable (YoY change < 2%), it signals strong economic growth without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.
